criteria.reason: The keyboard row adds Copy Last, Done, and Next buttons.
Done uses a 2:1:1 flex ratio, so it is narrower than the former full-width button.
Each action button is 48px high, exceeding the 44px minimum.
Copy Last receives the preceding set’s value for the active field and sends it through onChange.
Next changes the active field from weight to reps and loads the current set’s reps value.
The styling uses color and radius tokens, though Done’s text color is hardcoded as #fff.
The action row uses a flexible layout that can fit the keypad on mobile screens.
The button labels contain no exclamation marks or hype.
The harness reports all existing tests pass.
A new test checks that Copy Last sends the previous value to onChange.
